dict.string: Islet switches Dark Mode from Control Center through System Events, reads which web player a browser tab is playing (YouTube Music, Deezer, Qobuz…), and controls Apple Music or Spotify directly when the system Now Playing service is unavailable.
Islet's equalizer and live waveform process the music app's sound. Nothing is recorded or saved.
Islet turns Bluetooth on and off from Control Center in the island, and connects to the Islet app on your Android phone when there is no Wi-Fi.
Islet uses your camera only for Face ID, to recognise your face at the lock screen. Nothing from the camera is saved or leaves your Mac.
Islet uses your local network for Portal and for the Islet app on your Android phone: to send photos, files and links, and to show your phone’s notifications, calls and music on this Mac.
Islet shows the weather for where you are on the lock screen.
